Yellow houses run $150 each, so p4 could get 1-2 up quickly, but selling Atlantic would let me finish St James to 3 houses. Giving away a monopoly is risky long-term, but p2 and p3 are wealthy enough that p4 draining them might actually work in my favor, so I'll counter with $125.
